title: Orchard Fusion 果园大合成
description: A juicy Suika-style merge puzzle! Drop fruits into the orchard jar — identical fruits fuse into the next tier when they touch, chaining combos for multiplied scores. Grow your fruit from cherry all the way to a celebratory watermelon that clears small fruits for bonus points. One more drop could be one line too many: fruits resting above the danger line for 2 seconds end the run. Simple to learn, endlessly replayable, with satisfying physics, pop effects and a soothing synth soundtrack.
controls: Move with mouse (or touch-drag), release / tap to drop the fruit. Identical fruits merge on contact — chain merges in one drop for combo multipliers up to ×5. Press X or tap the Next box to swap current and next fruit (once per drop). P pauses, M mutes. Fruits resting above the red danger line for 2 seconds end the run.
author: LightGame
